topic: Defense lawyer calls out prosecutor's social media post during live impeachment trial
tweet1: Defense counsel Sheila Sison stopped the VP Sara Duterte impeachment trial to call out prosecutor Amando Ligutan—for a Facebook post he made *during the hearing*.
tweet2: Ligutan posted mid-trial about "misleading questions" after his co-counsel Lorna Kapunan clashed with defense lawyer Kristine Ferrer. Sison told the court: "It's inappropriate to do that to a fellow member of the bar."
tweet3: This isn't lawyer banter. Ligutan's post came out *while the cross-examination was still happening*—real-time commentary on his own case, visible to the public, while the witness was still on the stand.
tweet4: If prosecutors are live-tweeting their own trial strategy, the impeachment court has lost control of the proceeding. Expect Escudero to issue social media rules by tomorrow or lose what's left of courtroom discipline.
